---
title: "Survey questions: digitalisation and technology"
description-meta: "Ask firms which digital tools they use, from hardware and software to online sales, digital marketing and e-payments, using tested survey questions."
---

**Which of the following digital technologies does your company currently use?**
*(Select all that apply)*

- Cloud computing services (e.g. data storage, software as a service)
- Big data analytics
- Artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning
- Internet of Things (IoT) / connected devices or sensors
- Robotics or automated production systems
- 3D printing / additive manufacturing
- Blockchain or distributed ledger technology
- Augmented or virtual reality (AR/VR)
- None of the above

***

**What share of your company's total sales were made online (via website, app, or digital platform) in the last financial year?**

- None
- Less than 10%
- 10–24%
- 25–49%
- 50% or more

***

**Which of the following technological practices apply to the business?**

- More than 50% of employed people use computers with Internet access in their professional activity
- Call on services provided by ICT specialists (as own employees or outsourced services)
- Internet connection with guaranteed download speed of at least 30 Mbps
- More than 20% of employed people use mobile devices with internet connection
- Own a website or a web page
- It has a website with complex functions
- Use a social media network
- Pay for internet advertising
- It uses CC (Cloud Computing) services of high or at least medium complexity
- Issue electronic invoices that allow automatic processing
- Sales from e-Commerce activity exceed 1% of total turnover
- Business-to-consumer (B2C) web sales exceed 10% of total online sales
- None of the above

**Which digitised e-Government tools (online platforms that electronically provide government services and information to citizens) is the business currently using?**

- E-Government tools for business name
- E-Government tools for business registration
- E-Government tools for payment of licences
- E-Government tools for land registration
- Others

***

**Which financial data management tools is the business using? These tools are related to obtaining, storing and reviewing the business financial data.**

- The business accounting is kept using appropriate software
- Invoices and other primary accounting documents are issued and received electronically
- Accounting functions are performed using a computer application (processing invoices and payments, generating reports, performing audits, completing/submitting tax forms, etc.)
- Obtain information regarding billing, invoice confirmation, payment status
- Others
- None

***

**Which human resources management tools is the business using? These tools are related to streamlining communication and company-employee relations.**

- Salary calculation using appropriate software
- Management of holidays and days off using software connected to the financial accounting system
- Online tools that facilitate remote working
- Assigning tasks and tracking their fulfillment remotely using a computer system
- Track personal development/training and assess well-being and workplace atmosphere using a digital platform
- Others
- None

***

**Which customer relationship management tools is the business using? These tools are related to obtaining the order history for each customer, collaboration with customers is done using a digital system.**

- Identification/selection of customers according to specific parameters in the database
- Automatic updating of customer data (name, address, etc.) in the IT system
- Online purchase of the applicant's products/services
- Estimating sales volumes, analysing buying habits, organising discount campaigns, using customer data history analysis software
- Customers have online access to transaction status/history
- Others
- None

***

**Which resources management tools is the business using? These tools are related to the access of data about asset management (raw materials, inventory, financial resources, etc.)  from current digital systems.**

- The inventory of fixed assets is carried out through the scanning function with digital devices
- Automating/scheduling orders to prevent resource exhaustion or overstocking in advance using a software application
- Automatic calculation of transport and logistics costs (maintenance, fuel costs, routes, hours)
- Automatic calculation of the costs of goods/services
- Others
- None

***

**Which communication and customer relations tools is the business using? These tools are related to the access of online data based on keywords entered into search engines.**
- Defined keywords found in Internet search engines; web pages of the applicant adapted for this purpose
- Digital system for tracking customer interaction
- Online customer support system
- The number of customers attracted through the online environment
- Availability of information online for potential customers
- Others
- None

***

**Which processes digitalisation tools is the business using? These tools are related to the digitalisation of the processes within the business.**

- Digital approval/signature (using e.g. electronic signature) of documents, contracts, etc.
- Easy interconnection and exploitation of the various digital solutions implemented
- Assessment and monitoring of supplier/customer risks through IT systems
- Management of joint projects of employees from different departments using IT applications
- Others
- None

***

**Which security policy tools is the business using? These tools are related to the ability to quickly recover access to data in the event of its loss.**

- Identifying and analysing potential threats regarding data alteration or loss; prevention, detection, response and recovery measures
- Systematic training and education of employees regarding data security and IT security
- Measures against security breaches in telecommuting conditions
- Securing communications in the process of transmitting/storing commercial documents/data
- Others
- None

***

**Which production digitalisation tools is the business using? These tools are related to the automation/informatisation/digitalisation of the business production (does not apply to non-manufacturing applicants).**

- The production process includes measurement sensors that transmit data to servers in order to optimise production
- Real-time tracking of production processes by managers using computer systems
- Using RFI (Radio Frequency Identification) or other similar digital functionality to track parts and subassemblies or finished products in the manufacturing process
- Collaborative robots ( cobots ) in manufacturing
- Using systems that use virtual reality/augmented reality to train production/maintenance personnel or in other applications
- Others

***

- Digital tools and technologies
- Marketing and customer relationship tools
- e-Payments tools
- Record and financial management tools
- Human resources management tools
- Production digitisation tools
- Other
